translation: Wang Shuhe's Pulse Classic says: When both the cun and chi are floating, running straight up and down, this is the Governing Vessel. There is stiffness and pain of the lower back and spine, inability to bend and stretch; in adults, mania (dian); in children, wind-epilepsy (fengxian). He also said: When the pulse comes with the center floating and straight, moving up and down, it is the Governing Vessel.
